## Background on auditor choice

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
size_big4 = (
    funda
    .filter(
        pl.col("indfmt") == "INDL",
        pl.col("datafmt") == "STD",
        pl.col("consol") == "C",
        pl.col("popsrc") == "D",
        pl.col("sale") > 0,
        pl.col("at") > 0,
        pl.col("fyear") == 2019,
        pl.col("au").is_not_null()
    )
    .with_columns(
        au=pl.col("au").cast(pl.Int32),
        mkt_cap=pl.col("prcc_f") * pl.col("csho") * 1e6,
    )
    .with_columns(big4=pl.col("au").is_between(1, 8))
    .select("gvkey", "datadate", "fyear", "au", "big4", "mkt_cap")
    .sort("gvkey", "datadate")
)
```

## Simulation analysis

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
prob_big4 = (
    size_big4
    .filter(pl.col("mkt_cap") > 1e6)
    .select("big4", "mkt_cap")
    .with_columns(pl.col("mkt_cap").log10().name.prefix("log_"))
    .with_columns(
        bin=pl.col("log_mkt_cap").cut(
            np.arange(6.0, 12.25 + 0.25, 0.25),
            left_closed=False,
        )
    )
    .with_columns(
        p_big4=pl.col("big4").cast(pl.Float64).mean().over("bin")
    )
    .select("mkt_cap", "log_mkt_cap", "p_big4")
)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
n_firms = 5000
rng = np.random.default_rng(2021)

sim_auditor = (
    prob_big4
    .collect()
    .sample(n=n_firms, with_replacement=False, seed=2021)
    .with_row_index("id", offset=1)
    .with_columns(
        pl.Series("rand", rng.random(n_firms)),
        pl.Series("epsilon", rng.standard_normal(n_firms)),
    )
    .with_columns(
        big4=(pl.col("rand") < pl.col("p_big4")),
        audit_quality=(
            (pl.col("mkt_cap") ** (1 / 3)) * 0.003
            + pl.col("epsilon")
        ),
    )
    .select("id", "big4", "mkt_cap", "log_mkt_cap", "audit_quality")
)
```

The causal diagram for this simulation is $Z \rightarrow X$, $Z \rightarrow Y$, where $Z$ is market capitalization, $X$ is having a Big Four auditor, and the true coefficient on $X \rightarrow Y$ is zero (shown as a dashed arrow in the book).

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
fm = pf.feols(
    "audit_quality ~ big4 + I(mkt_cap / 1e9)",
    data=sim_auditor,
)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
sim_ps_data = sim_auditor.with_columns(
    treat=(~pl.col("big4")).cast(pl.Int8)
)

sim_fm = sm.GLM.from_formula(
    "treat ~ mkt_cap",
    data=sim_ps_data,
    family=sm.families.Binomial(),
).fit()

sim_match_pscores = (
    sim_ps_data
    .with_columns(
        pl.Series(
            "pscore",
            sim_fm.predict(sim_ps_data.to_pandas()),
        ),
    )
)

sim_matches = pl.from_pandas(
    NearestNeighborMatch(
        caliper=0.03, replace=False, ratio=1, shuffle=False
    ).match(
        data=sim_match_pscores.sort("pscore", descending=True).to_pandas(),
        treatment_col="treat",
        score_cols=["pscore"],
    )
).with_columns(subclass=pl.int_range(pl.len()).over("treat"))

fms_sim = {
    "MR": pf.feols("audit_quality ~ big4", data=sim_matches),
    "MR + controls": pf.feols(
        "audit_quality ~ big4 + I(mkt_cap / 1e9)",
        data=sim_matches,
    ),
}
```

## Replication of @Lawrence:2011tv

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: true
comp = (
    funda
    .filter(
        pl.col("indfmt") == "INDL",
        pl.col("datafmt") == "STD",
        pl.col("consol") == "C",
        pl.col("popsrc") == "D",
        pl.col("sich").is_not_null(),
        ~pl.col("sich").is_between(6000, 6999),
        pl.col("sale") > 0,
        pl.col("at") > 0,
        (pl.col("dltt") >= 0) | pl.col("dltt").is_null(),
        (pl.col("dlc") >= 0) | pl.col("dlc").is_null(),
        pl.col("prcc_f") * pl.col("csho") > 0,
        pl.col("ceq") > 0,
        pl.col("fyear").is_between(1988, 2006),
    )
    .select(
        "gvkey", "datadate", "fyear", "au", "prcc_f", "csho", "at", "ib",
        "dltt", "dlc", "rect", "ppent", "sale",
        "act", "lct", "sich", "oancf",
    )
    .sort("gvkey", "fyear")
    .with_columns(sic2=pl.col("sich").floordiv(100))
    .with_columns(curr=pl.col("act").era.div_if_pos("lct"))
    .with_columns(
        pl.col("fyear", "at", "sale", "rect", "curr")
        .shift(1)
        .over("gvkey")
        .name.prefix("lag_")
    )
    .with_columns(
        avg_at=(pl.col("lag_at") + pl.col("at")) / 2,
        d_sale=pl.col("sale") - pl.col("lag_sale"),
        d_rect=pl.col("rect") - pl.col("lag_rect"),
        accruals=pl.col("ib") - pl.col("oancf"),
        mkt_cap=pl.col("prcc_f") * pl.col("csho"),
    )
    .with_columns(
        log_at=pl.col("at").log(),
        aturn=pl.col("sale").era.div_if_pos("lag_at"),
        inv_avg_at=(
            pl.when(pl.col("avg_at") != 0)
            .then(1 / pl.col("avg_at"))
            .otherwise(None)
        ),
        d_sale_at=(
            (pl.col("d_sale") - pl.col("d_rect"))
            .era.div_if_pos("avg_at")
        ),
        ppe_at=(
            pl.col("ppent").era.div_if_pos("avg_at")
        ),
        lev=(pl.col("dltt") + pl.col("dlc").fill_null(0))
            .era.div_if_pos("avg_at"),
        roa=pl.col("ib").era.div_if_pos("avg_at"),
        ta=pl.col("accruals").era.div_if_pos("avg_at"),
        log_mkt=(
            pl.when(pl.col("mkt_cap") > 0)
            .then(pl.col("mkt_cap").log())
        ),
    )
    .with_columns(
        pl.col("lev", "roa")
        .shift(1)
        .over("gvkey")
        .name.prefix("lag_")
    )
    .filter(pl.col("lag_fyear") == (pl.col("fyear") - 1))
)

industries = (
    comp
    .group_by("fyear", "sic2")
    .agg(n_firms=pl.len())
    .filter(pl.col("n_firms") >= 10)
    .select("fyear", "sic2")
    .collect()
)

def get_klw_data(sic2: int, fyear: int) -> pl.DataFrame:
    reg_data = (
        comp
        .filter(pl.col("sic2") == sic2,
                pl.col("fyear") == fyear)
        .select(
            "gvkey", "fyear", "roa", "ta",
            "inv_avg_at", "d_sale_at", "ppe_at"
        )
        .drop_nulls()
        .collect()
    )

    if reg_data.height == 0:
        return pl.DataFrame()

    x = np.column_stack(
        [
            np.ones(reg_data.height),
            reg_data["inv_avg_at"].to_numpy(),
            reg_data["d_sale_at"].to_numpy(),
            reg_data["ppe_at"].to_numpy(),
        ]
    )
    y = reg_data["ta"].to_numpy()
    try:
        beta, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(x, y, rcond=None)
    except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
        return pl.DataFrame()

    results = reg_data.select("gvkey", "fyear", "roa").with_columns(
        da=pl.Series(name="da", values=(y - x @ beta))
    )

    pairs = (
        results
        .join(
            results.rename(
                {
                    "gvkey": "gvkey_match",
                    "roa": "roa_match",
                    "da": "da_match",
                }
            ),
            on="fyear",
            how="inner",
        )
        .filter(pl.col("gvkey") != pl.col("gvkey_match"))
    )
    if pairs.height == 0:
        return pl.DataFrame()

    return (
        pairs
        .with_columns(roa_diff=(pl.col("roa") - pl.col("roa_match")).abs())
        .sort("gvkey", "fyear", "roa_diff", "gvkey_match")
        .group_by("gvkey", "fyear")
        .first()
        .with_columns(ada=(pl.col("da") - pl.col("da_match")).abs())
        .select("gvkey", "fyear", "da", "ada")
    )

def psm_match(df: pl.DataFrame, caliper: float = 0.03) -> pl.DataFrame:
    match_covars = ["log_at", "log_mkt", "aturn", "curr", "lev", "roa"]
    reg_vars = ["ada", "big4", "log_mkt", "lag_roa", "lag_lev", "lag_curr", "sic2", "fyear"]

    d = (
        df
        .filter(pl.all_horizontal(pl.col(match_covars + reg_vars).is_not_null()))
        .with_columns(
            big4=pl.col("big4").cast(pl.Int8),
            treat=(pl.col("big4").cast(pl.Int8) == 0).cast(pl.Int8),
        )
    )

    d_ps = d.select("treat", *match_covars).to_pandas()
    ps_fm = sm.GLM.from_formula(
        "treat ~ log_at + log_mkt + aturn + curr + lev + roa",
        data=d_ps,
        family=sm.families.Binomial(),
    ).fit()

    d = d.with_columns(
        pscore=pl.Series("pscore", ps_fm.predict(d_ps).to_numpy())
    )

    matched_pd = NearestNeighborMatch(
        caliper=caliper,
        replace=False,
        ratio=1,
        random_state=2021,
    ).match(
        data=d.to_pandas(),
        treatment_col="treat",
        score_cols=["pscore"],
    )

    return (
        pl.from_pandas(matched_pd)
        .with_columns(
            big4=pl.col("big4").cast(pl.Int8),
            datadate=pl.col("datadate").cast(pl.Date),
        )
    )
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: false
# Lawrence replication: slow to run; run interactively if needed.
klw_results = pl.concat(
    [
        get_klw_data(**row)
        for row in industries.iter_rows(named=True)
    ],
    how="vertical",
)

full_sample = (
    comp
    .collect()
    .join(klw_results, on=["gvkey", "fyear"], how="inner")
    .filter(pl.col("avg_at") > 0)
    .with_columns(
        big4=pl.col("au").cast(pl.Int32).is_between(1, 8),
        mkt_cap=pl.col("prcc_f") * pl.col("csho"),
        log_mkt=(
            pl.when(pl.col("mkt_cap") > 0)
            .then(pl.col("mkt_cap").log())
        ),
    )
)

formula_klw = (
    "ada ~ big4 + log_mkt + lag_roa + lag_lev + lag_curr "
    "| sic2 + fyear"
)

fms_law = {
    "OLS": pf.feols(
        formula_klw,
        data=full_sample.with_columns(pl.col("big4").cast(pl.Int8))
    )
}

win_vars = [
    "ada", "log_mkt", "lag_roa", "lag_lev", "lag_curr",
    "roa", "lev", "curr", "mkt_cap"
]

full_sample_win = (
    full_sample
    .with_columns(pl.col(win_vars).era.winsorize(),
                  pl.col("big4").cast(pl.Int8))
)

fms_law["OLS, win"] = pf.feols(formula_klw, data=full_sample_win)
```

```{python}
#| include: false
#| eval: false
# PSM matching on real data: slow to run; run interactively if needed.
lmz_matched = psm_match(full_sample, caliper=0.03)
fms_law["PSM"] = pf.feols(formula_klw, data=lmz_matched)

lmz_matched_win = psm_match(full_sample_win, caliper=0.03)
fms_law["PSM, win"] = pf.feols(formula_klw, data=lmz_matched_win)
```
